annotations.title: Google data: web, news, trends, Maps, ads

description: One node for Google: web pages, news, trends, Maps businesses and reviews, keyword search volume and advertisers' Google ads. Each action has a price. Use it when: A task needs Google: current information from the web, news, search interest and volume, local businesses and their reputation, or a competitor's ads. Not for: Anything behind a login, or ad spend figures. Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Typical time: about 30 s. Actions: web_pages (search the web and read the top pages as text; needs query); news (recent news on a topic; needs query); trends (whether interest in a topic is rising or falling; needs keyword); maps_search (local businesses on google maps; needs query, location); maps_reviews (google reviews of one business; needs business); keyword_volume (monthly search volume and cost per click for a keyword; needs keyword); ads (ads an advertiser runs on google search, youtube and display; needs query). Price: from $0.014 per call, charged only on success. Price depends on action: maps_reviews $0.014, keyword_volume $0.016, web_pages $0.017, news $0.035, trends $0.037, maps_search $0.042, ads $0.045 (default web_pages). One call = one Google action (web, news, trends, Maps, keywords or ads).

action.description: What to do; sets the price. web_pages (needs query), news (needs query), trends (needs keyword), maps_search (needs query, location), maps_reviews (needs business), keyword_volume (needs keyword), ads (needs query). Default web_pages

business.description: Business name and city, e.g. Franklin Barbecue Austin (for: maps_reviews)

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, uppercase, e.g. US, GB, DE; leave out for worldwide (for: trends)

keyword.description: One keyword or phrase, e.g. ai agents (for: trends, keyword_volume)

language.description: Two-letter language code, e.g. en, de; default en (for: keyword_volume)

location.description: City, area or address, e.g. Austin, Texas, USA (for: maps_search)

market.description: Two-letter country code, lowercase, e.g. us, gb, de; default us (for: keyword_volume)

period.description: How far back to look; default 7d (for: news)

query.description: What to search for, in plain words (single line) (for: web_pages, news, maps_search, ads)

region.description: Two-letter country code, uppercase, e.g. US, GB, DE; default US (for: ads)

timeframe.description: Time window; default today 12-m (last 12 months) (for: trends)
